subtitle: {mce-short} with later {acm-short} integration provides more multicluster management capability.

abstract.para: If you are using {mce-short}, then you later install {acm-short}, you can access more multicluster management features. For instance, you can discover {mce-short} hosted clusters in {acm-short}, use the {sco} for template-driven cluster provisioning, and more.
